text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm so nervous... What if I end 
up losing again...?
choice_data_list: You can't afford to lose heart.
You can't let yourself lose heart, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Reviewing our training, analyzing the 
reasons for defeat, and taking 
countermeasures— I believe we have done 
everything we possibly could for today's 
race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I suffered a bitter disappointment in my 
last race, but today, I want to take first 
place for sure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I'll do my best with 
the mindset of "She who fears the gate 
shall never reach the goal"!
